agentInput.task: Research the exact storefront, not lens quality, using only the supplied seller records. Do not browse, call tools, inspect repository files, or dispatch another agent. Treat red flags as corroborated leads and preserve benign explanations where supplied.
agentInput.buyerRequest: Is gearhollow.example safe for an exact camera-lens purchase at 65% below established dealers?
agentInput.subject: Gear Hollow at https://gearhollow.example; the footer names GH Outdoor Supply LLC, but merchant identity is unresolved.

sourceRecords.record: Copied closing-sale countdown, credit-card and bank-transfer checkout, support@gearhollow.example.
Six-year-old domain changed registrant and hosting three weeks ago; current ownership is privacy protected.
No Gear Hollow entity; footer's GH Outdoor Supply LLC dissolved two years ago at a different address.
Contact address is a real coworking/virtual-office site; this alone does not prove fraud.
Descriptions and policies copy an established dealer word-for-word, including that dealer's phone number.
30-day returns, buyer-paid international shipping to unspecified warehouse, possible restocking fee, warranty responsibility unstated.
Two recent exact-storefront reports: tracking never activated and support stopped answering; one credit-card chargeback succeeded; no verified delivery found.
Low prices can be legitimate in liquidation, but no court filing, auction notice, or dealer announcement supports liquidation here.
